Release age
(best effort)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="62" width="112" x="500" y="285" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=10;align=center;" value="2. CVE line
(OSV mirror)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="62" width="112" x="622" y="285" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=10;align=center;" value="3. Digest verify
(before unpack)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="62" width="112" x="744" y="285" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=10;align=center;" value="4. Org plugins
(after unpack)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="62" width="112" x="866" y="285" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g5" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=10;align=center;" value="5. AI review
(optional, last)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="62" width="112" x="988" y="285" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="gateend" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=10;fontColor=#b85450;whiteSpace=wrap;" value="Every gate is fail-closed: a check that cannot run is Unverifiable, never a serve.

packument), then the plugins at the download, which also requires that earlier admission." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="600" x="500" y="360" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="stores" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#666666;" value="DURABLE STATE (SQLite)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="24" width="300" x="500" y="440" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;align=center;" value="verdicts

div.div:
Every gate is fail-closed: a check that cannot run is Unverifiable, never a serve.
This order is the PyPI path, where one full scan runs all five.
cargo and npm split it: CVE, release age and AI review at the metadata gate (sparse index /
packument), then the plugins at the download, which also requires that earlier admission.

The audit endpoints are answered locally
and never proxied: shipping the org's
dependency tree upstream is a data-egress
change nobody asked for.
